purpose: The app's navigation rail: a brand header with a fold trigger, labelled groups of destination rows and an optional footer. Collapsed it becomes a 48 px icon rail.

notFor.case: A few top-level destinations that fit a header.
A temporary panel over the page.

Collapsed=false.visual: 272 px wide on Surface/layer-1 with a Border/default hairline on the right; labels and group labels shown.

Collapsed=true.meaning: Folded by the trigger or by the app.
Collapsed=true.visual: The 48 px icon rail: rows become squares, labels and group labels are hidden, the brand shows only its logo.

a11y.keyboard: Tab moves through the trigger and each row; the trigger is a button that folds and unfolds the rail.
notes: An aside landmark with an aria-label.
The trigger carries aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Collapsed rows keep an accessible name and want a Tooltip with their label.
Keep at most one row marked as the current page.

openQuestions: Motion: the Collapsed axis has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry (finding MOT-002). Should folding the rail animate its width?
